title: 第三章 炼制妖皇丹第四章 觉醒上古血脉
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
"妙菱过来吃饭了。”
“我辟谷了，不吃饭。”安妙菱回了一句，继续练剑。
“吃饭是我藏剑峰的规矩，必须吃。”秦天严肃的说道。
安妙菱无奈的把剑收了起来，往秦天那边走去。
桌上一汤，两菜。
汤是三足乌鸡汤，然后就是清炒灵叶和爆炒千年地笋。
安妙菱刚坐下就闻到了菜香。
秦天笑了笑道：
“修行境界分为：脱凡，超凡，灵动，金身，涅槃，造化，半圣，圣境，帝境。”
“每一个境界又细分为一重，二重，三重。”
“吃完这顿饭，你应该就能突破到金身境一重了。”
安妙菱看了看桌上的汤和菜有些不信。
秦天拿起一个碗，盛了一碗肉汤递给了安妙菱。
“吃饭前先喝点汤对肠胃好。”
安妙菱愣了下，这不是世俗的说法吗！
上一世她出生世俗，她娘也和她说过这种话。
只是后来她家破人亡，在逃避仇家的过程中她几经磨难。
最后才修得绝情道心，成就女帝尊位。
她端起汤喝了一口，确实非常鲜美，但是等她吞进肚子后，整个人呆住了。
随后她直接把这碗汤一股脑喝了，喝完汤，她就开始吃肉。

吃完后，她感觉一股庞大的能量涌入体内，身上也开始散发出微弱的金光。
随后金光慢慢变强，周遭的灵力迅速被她吸入体内。
良久，她顺利的突破到了金身境一重。
“你给我吃的什么？”安妙菱惊讶的问道。
“也没啥，就是三足乌鸡王熬得鸡汤。”
“你用妖王熬汤？”安妙菱一下震惊到了。
“这是你抓的，还是上一任峰主江轻雪抓得？”
“江轻雪抓的。”
这次安妙菱有些不信了。
还有就是，一个吃经常妖王肉的人，怎么可能只是灵动境。
就算是一头普通的猪也能喂到涅槃境。
她越来越感觉自己这个师傅不一般了。
秦天笑了笑道，“谁还没有秘密呢！我知道你也有秘密。”
听到这句话，安妙菱一下紧张了起来，难道他知道自己是女帝转世？
看着安妙菱紧张的表情，秦天突然觉得挺可爱的。
content_en:
"Miao Ling is here for dinner."
"I'm fasting and won't eat." An Miaoling replied and continued practicing her sword.
"Eating is my rule at Hidden Sword Peak. You must eat." Qin Tian said seriously.
An Miaoling put away her sword helplessly and walked towards Qin Tian.
There is one soup and two dishes on the table.
The soup is three-legged black-bone chicken soup, followed by stir-fried spiritual leaves and stir-fried thousand-year-old bamboo shoots.
An Miaoling smelled the aroma of vegetables as soon as she sat down.
Qin Tian smiled and said:
"The realms of practice are divided into: transcendental, extraordinary, spiritual, golden body, nirvana, creation, semi-saint, holy realm, and imperial realm."
"Each realm is subdivided into first level, second level, and third level."
"After this meal, you should be able to break through to the first level of the Golden Body Realm."
An Miaoling looked at the soup and vegetables on the table with disbelief.
Qin Tian picked up a bowl, filled a bowl of broth and handed it to An Miaoling.
"Drinking some soup before eating is good for your stomach."
An Miaoling was stunned for a moment, isn't this a secular saying?
In her last life, she was born in a secular world, and her mother also said this to her.
But later her family was destroyed, and she went through many hardships while escaping from her enemies.
In the end, he cultivated a ruthless Taoist heart and achieved the title of Empress.
She picked up the soup and took a sip. It was indeed very delicious, but when she swallowed it, she was stunned.
Then she drank the bowl of soup directly. After drinking the soup, she started eating meat.
After eating, she felt a huge amount of energy pouring into her body, and her body began to emit a faint golden light.
Then the golden light slowly became stronger, and the surrounding spiritual energy was quickly absorbed into her body.
After a long time, she successfully broke through to the first level of the Golden Body Realm.
"What did you give me to eat?" An Miaoling asked in surprise.
"It's nothing, just three-legged black chicken king making chicken soup."
"You used Demon King to make soup?" An Miaoling was shocked.
"Did you catch it, or did the previous peak master Jiang Qingxue catch it?"
"Jiang Qingxue caught him."
This time An Miaoling didn't believe it.
Also, how could a person who often eats the flesh of the demon king be in the spiritual realm?
Even an ordinary pig can be fed to the state of nirvana.
She felt more and more that her master was something special.
Qin Tian smiled and said, "Who doesn't have a secret yet? I know you have a secret too."
Hearing these words, An Miaoling became nervous. Did he know that he was the reincarnation of the empress?
Seeing An Miaoling's nervous expression, Qin Tian suddenly felt cute.
